name: Getalong Enterprise Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2020, Getalong Enterprise Ltd is in the business of offering tax solutions & allied 
services.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
GAEL is an ISO 9001:2015 certified company which is in the business of providing Tax Consultancy Services that include:
a) Income Tax Compliance Service
b) GST Compliance Service
c) Tax Planning & Advisory Service
d) Litigation & Assessments
e) Accounting Services
f) PAN/TAN Centre (Protean)
g) Allied Services

pros: Stock is trading at 1.14 times its book value
Debtor days have improved from 1,805 to 58.3 days.
Promoter holding has increased by 1.11% over last quarter.
cons: Company has a low return on equity of 11.4% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.0.36 Cr.
